name: VoiceDash
description: Experimental Android voice input for Geometry Dash: sustain a vocalization to hold Jump, then release on silence.

voice-title.name: Voice input
voice-title.description: Voice control is off by default and captures audio only while enabled during an active level.

voice-enabled.name: Enable voice control
voice-enabled.description: Enable microphone input during levels. The Android host app must declare and grant RECORD_AUDIO.

activation-threshold.name: Voice activation threshold
activation-threshold.description: Higher values reject more background noise but require a louder vocalization.

release-threshold.name: Voice release threshold
release-threshold.description: Threshold for starting the silence countdown. Keep this below the activation threshold.

minimum-periodicity.name: Minimum voice periodicity
minimum-periodicity.description: Higher values reject more noisy sounds but may miss breathy vocalizations.

attack-ms.name: Activation confirmation (ms)
attack-ms.description: How long audio must stay above threshold before pressing Jump.

release-ms.name: Release confirmation (ms)
release-ms.description: How long audio must stay below the release threshold before releasing Jump.
